reference_limit: Published commercial camera site and building footprint; microphone not surveyed. Check video continuity and camera changes before accuracy interpretation.
scope: New recording at a familiar benchmark site, not an unseen-site test. Use the public released EXE in a GitHub Windows VM with an initially empty flight cache. No detector tuning from this result.

warnings: Experimental: candidate rankings are not calibrated location probabilities or a verified fix.

LAX public airport data covers its local radar area. Altitudes are converted from MSL to WGS84 using EGM96; their original sensor/pressure provenance is unknown. Recorded coverage does not establish that every flight is present.
Passage timing includes 149 short flight segments with 3 to 7 recorded positions. Positions are not added and gaps are not extended.
243 flight segments have unknown aircraft type. Load the type catalog or use propeller-only mode to exclude unclassified aircraft.
Flight positions use a centered 10-second local linear fit to reduce quantization noise. Track endpoints, gaps and timestamps are preserved; curved/accelerating motion may still incur model error.
Missing/void terrain used the configured fallback height of 0 m (Egm96). Candidate heights are WGS84 ellipsoid heights.

The timing score exceeded all 19 shuffled controls. The evaluated locations within a likelihood factor of 100 fit within 1 km of the reported region center. This is a model screen, not a verified accuracy radius.

Passage timing uses nearby aircraft, a fixed media clock rate and a timing width of 1 seconds. Speech, missing flights, changing sound power and nonstationary noise can invalidate this model. See the limitations document for result interpretation.
